Consider the set B, defined as B={n3−4:n∈Z,−2≤n≤2}.

Which of the following sets is equivalent to B?

{−12,−5,−4,−3,4}
b
{−12,−5,0,1,2}
c
{−12,−5,−4,−3,−2}
d
{−12,−5,4,5,12}
